A7-failure-states-browser-fixture.title: Show failed and canceled changes truthfully in a browser fixture
A7-failure-states-browser-fixture.desc:
## Context
OVD-520 AC2 requires truthful execution versus verification states. AC4 requires that failure blocks the successor.

No browser test shows a failed Change 1 with a blocked Change 2, and none shows the canceled outcome. The restart spec covers only the verified and recovery_required terminal states (e2e/engineering-browser-reopen.spec.ts:11).

The labels exist in EngineeringTaskStatus.tsx:16-19. 'Failed' is both an execution label and a verification label, so page-wide text matches would be vacuous. Each card is an `article` named 'Change N' containing dt/dd pairs (:153-159). EngineeringStepReview only reads the STEP review RPC after a succeeded+passed task is found (EngineeringStepReview.tsx:22-42).

## Scope
One new test-only spec, e2e/engineering-failure-states.spec.ts, tagged @fixture. It uses a Node-side route mock, copying the interception pattern from engineering-browser-reopen.spec.ts without editing that file. No runtime source changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Field-scoped exact assertions:
  - Change 1: Execution 'Failed', Verification 'Failed', Current attempt 'Attempt failed'.
  - Change 2: Execution 'Blocked', Verification 'Unverified', Current attempt 'No current attempt recorded'.
- [ ] 'Candidate geometry unavailable' is shown, the region 'Exact STEP review' contains 0 canvases, and api_read_native_step_review is never requested.
- [ ] No retry or cancel buttons exist. Zero non-GET requests reach the API origin.
- [ ] After the simulated backend cancels both tasks and the task-read counter increases:
  - Change 1 shows Execution 'Canceled' and Verification still 'Failed';
  - Change 2 shows Execution 'Canceled' and Verification 'Unverified';
  - geometry is still unavailable.
- [ ] The evidence attachment says `simulationOnly: true`.
- [ ] Mutation: a mocked Change 2 of 'queued' fails the spec.
- [ ] `npm run e2e:fixture` gives 22 passed (baseline 21).

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock env PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_AUTH_SETUP=1 npx playwright test e2e/engineering-failure-states.spec.ts --repeat-each=5
flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock npm run e2e:fixture
npx eslint e2e/engineering-failure-states.spec.ts && npm run typecheck
flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify
```

## Out of scope
- Owner cancel or retry UI.
- Any EngineeringTaskStatus or EngineeringStepReview change.
- Provenance labels.
- Edits to existing specs.

ERROR-SANITIZATION-SCOPED.title: Keep secrets and stack traces out of customer-visible errors
ERROR-SANITIZATION-SCOPED.desc:
## Context
Verified on #564 (084b48c5):
- src/components/debug/AppErrorBoundary.tsx:85 renders `this.state.error.message` verbatim to customers.
- src/lib/error-message.ts `getUserFacingErrorMessage` returns raw Error and record messages. For records without a message it returns the JSON of the compacted record, which error-message.test.ts pins in 'serializes PostgREST-style objects when needed'.
- So strings the server provides, such as JWT-shaped tokens, emails or stack frames, can reach toasts and dialogs.
- #564's quote-confirmation lane renders the real ClientPart page with every request intercepted. Its config sets testMatch `*.browser.ts`, and CI runs it in the step 'Test Free quote confirmation and replay in browser'.

## Scope
Tests come first:
- `e2e/quote-confirmation/errors.browser.ts` makes RPC failures (a scope-lookup 400, a dispatch 500, a quote-access error) whose bodies carry five sentinels: a JWT-shaped string (three base64url segments starting with eyJ), 'service_role', 'storageState', a stack frame such as 'at fn (https://x.invalid/a.js:1:2)', and an email address. It asserts that no sentinel appears in any toast, dialog or body text, and that a finite message plus a next action (retry or close) is shown.
- Unit cases in src/lib/error-message.test.ts.
- A new src/components/debug/AppErrorBoundary.test.tsx.
- A unit case for the upload toast in src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.ts.

The minimal fix:
- a tested deny-pattern list applied to the final string in getUserFacingErrorMessage, where a match returns the fallback, default 'Something went wrong.';
- AppErrorBoundary renders the raw message only when import.meta.env.DEV, and otherwise 'Something went wrong.'. The heading, the Reference id and Reload stay.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Failure first, recorded: errors.browser.ts shows at least one sentinel before the fix. If nothing leaks in this lane, the new unit tests show the leak through getUserFacingErrorMessage or AppErrorBoundary.
- [ ] After the fix, `npm run e2e:quote-confirmation` passes, existing and new cases alike, and vitest passes for error-message, AppErrorBoundary and use-client-job-file-picker.
- [ ] Positive control: existing customer-facing server messages without sentinels still display unchanged, for example 'Founding Beta access and current notice acceptance are required.'.
- [ ] The pinned test 'serializes PostgREST-style objects when needed' is unchanged unless its payload matches a deny pattern. Replacing PostgREST JSON wholesale is an open owner question.
- [ ] No new copy: only the existing default 'Something went wrong.'.
- [ ] scripts/quote-confirmation-browser-contract.test.mjs passes. quote.browser.ts and testMatch are untouched.

## Verification commands

ACCOUNT-SWITCH-NAV-LEAK-FIX.title: Clear the cached workspace navigation model on account or scope change
ACCOUNT-SWITCH-NAV-LEAK-FIX.desc:
## Context (verified 2026-10-04)
Draft PR #583 (branch claude/access-scope-enrollment-e2e, stacked on the #564 release base) added browser case 4 in e2e/access-scope.spec.ts: sign out in-tab, then sign in as a different user (outsider.demo, org 2). In 4 of 6 runs with 2 workers, and in both full-lane runs, the outsider briefly saw client.demo's parts list on /parts. Root cause found by the implementer: `useWorkspaceNavigationModel` (src/features/quotes/use-workspace-navigation-model.ts, `stableModelRef` ~line 203, plus `lastRejectedStateRef` / `lastCommittedSignatureRef`) keeps the last coherent model in React refs that are not keyed by the signed-in user or access scope. ClientParts renders `navigationModel.parts` and `sidebarProjects` from that ref, so the `queryClient.removeQueries` purge in src/hooks/use-app-session.ts cannot clear it. Case 4 is currently gated behind `E2E_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_LEAK_CHECK=1` (e2e/access-scope.spec.ts ~line 352).
This violates release-proof R9 ("logout, account/org switch and role changes synchronously remove prior-scope rendered/cache data before exposing the next session") and is a cross-account exposure class defect.

## Scope
- Key every cached/stabilized navigation state in useWorkspaceNavigationModel (and any sibling hook found to keep a similar unkeyed ref feeding customer-visible lists) by the authenticated user id plus the active organization/access scope. When the key changes (including to signed-out), synchronously reset to the empty model before rendering any data, so no frame shows the previous scope's rows.
- Remove the `E2E_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_LEAK_CHECK` gate so case 4 always runs.

PRIV-DEFINER-ALLOWLIST.title: Pin the anon/authenticated SECURITY DEFINER and table-privilege inventory
PRIV-DEFINER-ALLOWLIST.desc:
## Context
Verified on #574 (ac5026fe):
- #571 (20261003150000) revokes public.log_audit_event from anon, authenticated and PUBLIC. #573 and #574 add new RPCs.
- No test pins, catalog-wide, which SECURITY DEFINER functions anon, authenticated or PUBLIC can execute, and none pins the table ACL posture.
- 45 public tables still grant TRUNCATE to anon. That is known debt; whether to revoke it is Q35, an owner decision.
- scripts/run-supabase-policy-tests.mjs picks up every file under supabase/tests, so a new suite runs in CI without registration. The runner rejects SKIP, TODO and empty evidence.

## Scope
One new file, `supabase/tests/api_role_privilege_inventory.sql`. It characterizes current privileges only and revokes nothing. Each check is a set_eq against a reviewed allowlist:
1. SECURITY DEFINER functions in public, private and engineering_private that anon can execute.
2. The same, for authenticated.
3. The same, for PUBLIC: aclexplode over coalesce(proacl, acldefault('f', proowner)) with grantee 0.
4. Public tables (relkind r/p) without relrowsecurity: an empty set, or pinned exceptions.
5. Policies on public tables whose polroles include anon or PUBLIC: the characterized set.
6. Privileges that anon and authenticated hold on engineering_* tables: the characterized set.
7. Public tables where anon has TRUNCATE: exactly the current 45-table known-debt list.

Allowlist rows have the form (signature regprocedure::text, guard_class, issue). guard_class takes one of these values:
- verified-auth+membership
- internal-role
- admin-aal2
- intended-public-read
- known-debt

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The suite passes on #574's head after a reset, with an exact plan(N).
- [ ] Mutation probes run in scratch copies whose prefix is rolled back:
  - a new public SECURITY DEFINER function without a revoke makes checks 1-3 fail;
  - a new public table with anon TRUNCATE makes checks 4 and 7 fail.
- [ ] Sensitivity: the same file run at 084b48c5 (#564's head, before #571) lists public.log_audit_event in the anon, authenticated and PUBLIC diffs. Diffs from the missing #573/#574 RPCs are expected there and noted.
- [ ] On the OVD-598 and SERVER-EMPTY heads, when they are pushed, the sets are unchanged and recorded.
- [ ] Every allowlist entry has a guard_class and an issue. The known-debt entries are listed in the PR body.
- [ ] The full `supabase test db --local` run passes, and CI 'Test database policies' is green.

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/api_role_privilege_inventory.sql'
flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local'
flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/zz_probe_privilege_inventory.sql'   # scratch copy, deleted afterwards
```

## Out of scope
- Revoking any grant (Q35).
- Fixing GAP-B5.
- Editing other suites.
